name: print-social-red-cola-can-stage-with-swallow-screens-and-light-bars
title: Red stage render with a giant can, a fan of screens with golden swallows and red light bars over a runway
whatItIs: A saturated red stage where a giant cylinder can sits at the centre wrapped with gold swallows and a blossom, surrounded by a radial fan of red screens each showing a gold swallow and glowing red light bars, with a runway leading to a figure and a caption 'Gắn kết Tết diệu kỳ' and silhouetted crowds.
whatItMeans: Festive and grand; radial screens and one red world make a brand feel like a celebration.
techniques: Arrange screens radially around a hero object.
Flood the whole scene in one brand red.
Repeat a gold motif on every screen.
Add a runway leading to the centre.

vocabulary.definition: Screens arranged like rays around a centre.
A giant product cylinder as the centrepiece.
An entire scene in one brand colour.
